description: Every builtin the SauceScript reference (saucescript.md) documents, with one example program per target it is available on. Each program is a complete SauceScript module, compiled as the entry `main.js`: for each target in `targets` it must compile. For each `unavailable` entry, compiling `program` for that target must fail with a message containing `error`. An entry listing `contracts` binds those ABIs, from `abis`, as `inlineContracts: [[name, abis[name]]]`.

const OWNER = 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111n;
function main(): void { require(ctx.msgSender() == OWNER); }
